PROGRAM
  MAPPING
    MAPPING_HEADER
      IDENT "User"
      SHAPE_SEP ":"
      IDENT "ex"
      SHAPE_SEP ":"
      IDENT "Person"
      KW_FROM "from"
      IDENT "users"
    MAPPING_BODY
      PROPERTY
        PROPERTY_LHS
          KW_IRI "iri"
        ASSIGN "="
        EXPR
          PIPELINE_EXPR
            PIPELINE_EXPR
              PIPELINE_EXPR
                LITERAL_EXPR
                  IDENT "users"
                PIPE "|>"
                POSTFIX_EXPR
                  LITERAL_EXPR
                    IDENT "filter"
                  LPAREN "("
                  ARG_LIST
                    ARG
                      BINARY_EXPR
                        FIELD_REF_EXPR
                          DOT "."
                          IDENT "age"
                        GE ">="
                        LITERAL_EXPR
                          INTEGER "18"
                  RPAREN ")"
              PIPE "|>"
              POSTFIX_EXPR
                LITERAL_EXPR
                  IDENT "map"
                LPAREN "("
                ARG_LIST
                  ARG
                    FIELD_REF_EXPR
                      DOT "."
                      IDENT "name"
                RPAREN ")"
            PIPE "|>"
            POSTFIX_EXPR
              LITERAL_EXPR
                IDENT "sort"
              LPAREN "("
              ARG_LIST
                ARG
                  PARTIAL_EXPR
                    PARTIAL "_"
              RPAREN ")"
